title.en: MALACAÑANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING CERTAIN MUNICIPAL DISTRICTS IN THE PHILIPPINES AS MUNICIPALITIES
title.orig: MALACAÑANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING CERTAIN MUNICIPAL DISTRICTS IN THE PHILIPPINES AS MUNICIPALITIES

text.en:
The present elective municipal district officials shall
continue as such officials of the respective newly declared
municipalities until the new officials thereof shall have
been elected in the next general elections and shall have
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-three.
DIOSDADO MACAPAGAI
President of the Philipines
By the President:
SALVADOR, L. MARIÑO
Executive Secretary
